Description (en): A DEX for the Polkadot Asset Hub
Polkadot's First Feline & the Cutest Pirate Onchain
Lion's on vacation, so I'm stepping in!

dotUSD is Polkadot's native USD-pegged stablecoin on Asset Hub, governed by Polkadot OpenGov. Launched through Referendum 1944, its first phase enables minting and redemption against USDT via a capped Peg Stability Module. DOT-collateralized vaults are planned for a later phase.
Description (zh): dotUSD 是 Polkadot 在 Asset Hub 上的原生美元锚定稳定币，由 Polkadot OpenGov 治理。该资产通过第 1944 号公投推出，第一阶段通过设有额度上限的锚定稳定模块（PSM）支持以 USDT 铸造和赎回。以 DOT 为抵押品的金库机制计划在后续阶段推出。

Description (en): GameDAO

JIN has two, permanent versions: Jinex Token and Jinex Coin, each with its own utilities. Always 2-way convertible between them.

**Jinex Token (JIN)** - "MultiToken" version on Enjin Matrixchain
- Used primarily as an intrinsic store of value, via ENJ Infusions, an on-chain feature of Enjin Blockchain.
- Pay fees with JIN for -50% on all DeFi features fees.
- No decimal token.

**Jinex Coin (JIN)** - "Asset" version on Polkadot AssetHub, later Enjin Matrixchain, then Jinex Matrixchain.
- Used primarily for exchanges.
- Pay fees with JIN for -50% on all DEX (multi-chain) features fees.
- Governance (crypto creation proposals etc).
- Once Jinex Matrixchain is live, will be used for gas and all chain actions.

Learn more: [jinex.io](https://jinex.io) | [docs.jinex.io](https://docs.jinex.io)
Description (zh):
JIN 有两个永久版本：Jinex Token 和 Jinex Coin，各自拥有独立的用途。它们之间始终支持双向兑换。

**Jinex Token (JIN)** - 位于 Enjin Matrixchain 上的"MultiToken"（多代币）版本
- 主要作为内在的价值存储，通过 Enjin 区块链的链上功能 ENJ Infusions 实现。
- 使用 JIN 支付费用，可享受所有 DeFi 功能手续费 50% 的折扣 (-50%)。
- 无小数位代币（不可分割）。

**Jinex Coin (JIN)** - 位于 Polkadot AssetHub 上的"Asset"（资产）版本，后续将上线 Enjin Matrixchain，最终登陆 Jinex Matrixchain。
- 主要用于交易平台和兑换。
- 使用 JIN 支付费用，可享受所有 DEX（多链）功能手续费 50% 的折扣 (-50%)。
- 用于治理（如加密资产创建提案等）。
- 一旦 Jinex Matrixchain 上线，将用于支付 Gas 费以及所有的链上操作。

了解更多：[jinex.io](https://jinex.io) | [docs.jinex.io](https://docs.jinex.io)

Description (en): dog wif dots the new Polkadot mascot, being literally just dog wif dots

Gavun Wud is a community-driven Polkadot memecoin inspired by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder of Ethereum and Polkadot. It aims to unite Web3 enthusiasts and onboard new users into the Polkadot ecosystem through engaging meme art, NFTs, AI agent and gaming experiences.
Description (zh): Gavun Wud是由社区驱动的Polkadot memecoin,灵感来自Dr。Ethereum和Polkadot的共同创始人Gavin Wood。它旨在通过吸引模因艺术,NFT,AI代理和游戏体验,将Web3爱好者和新用户加入Polkadot生态系统。

Description (en): DamnDAO is a quantitative trading decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) based on Polkadot, with a meme community character. It is positioned as a “Quant + Meme” DAO. The project focuses on quantitative trading strategies and community governance on Polkadot, covering areas such as arbitrage and liquidity provision.
Description (zh): DamnDAO 是一个基于 Polkadot 的量化交易去中心化自治组织（Quantitative Trading DAO），同时带有 Meme 社区属性，定位是「量化 + Meme」DAO。 项目专注于 Polkadot 上的量化交易策略与社区治理，涵盖套利和流动性提供等业务。
